summary: You present a relevant Australian coral-monitoring mission, identify its broad purpose and users, and provide a readable timetable with a labelled Gantt chart (Image 1). To reach the next rubric level, turn the concept into a technically supported design, strengthen the project plan with sources and contingencies, and resolve inconsistencies in the orbit description and schedule.
next_steps: In Mission Concept & Rationale, specify the instrument and measurable coverage, revisit, and resolution requirements, and explain how the satellite would meet users’ needs. Correct the ocean-acidification wording: surface acidity has increased by about 30% (pH has decreased).

In Project Plan & Preliminary Progress, correct the 600 km orbit description: this is low Earth orbit, not geostationary. Assess whether your proposed orbit, communications and ground segment can support the claimed coverage and relay; list the information sources you plan to use and add contingency tasks to the plan.

Use the next project stage to produce and interpret technical outputs, such as orbit or coverage calculations or STK results. Align Image 1’s weeks 9–10 finalisation with the text’s weeks 7–8 schedule, and make citations and the reference list consistent.

criteria.C1: Adequate: your Mission Concept & Rationale identifies the need, broad function and likely users, with supporting sources. For Accomplished, define the instrument and specific coverage, revisit and resolution requirements, and show how the capability serves users. The near-real-time service claim needs technical support.
criteria.C2: Adequate: your project plan gives a mission-relevant sequence and task descriptions. For Accomplished, add robust contingencies, systematically identify information sources, explain how the plan follows from the mission concept, and reconcile the schedule in Image 1 with the text.
criteria.C3: Deficient: you report background reading and STK tutorials, but no technical results or interpretation. For Adequate, include useful preliminary design work, such as calculations or STK outputs, with a brief explanation of what they show; first correct the orbit description.
criteria.C4: Adequate: headings, readable prose and a labelled Gantt chart make the report understandable. For Accomplished, use consistent in-text citations and a matching reference list, keep the chart and narrative schedule consistent, and explain software selection.
